basis: PHASE1_DESIGN_PACKAGE_20261013.md §4, as amended by the Phase A review fixes (Issue #1 comment 6155160682): sources #2, #4, #5 are PARKED-SOURCE until a primary source replaces the summary/mirror; SOURCE_CHAT is a writer channel, not a scraped source.
rules: A card whose primary source class is PARKED-SOURCE fails NEW-intake validation (SOURCE_PARKED). Migrated v1 cards keep their historical record but are flagged parked_primary_source and cannot be newly shortlisted on that primary alone.
Secondary sources (#5, #6, #7 classes) may support a card but never serve as its primary (source.is_primary must be true and the class must not be secondary-only).
A failed source never blocks a run and is never substituted by an unverified mirror; the writer logs SOURCE_DOWN.

sources.access_basis_default: arXiv abstract page / PDF — arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; metadata and abstract freely reusable
sources.name: arXiv q-fin (export.arxiv.org listings, abs pages, PDFs)

sources.access_basis_default: SSRN abstract page — abstract only; full text not fetched
sources.name: SSRN eLibrary abstract pages
sources.parked_reason: Review fix: parked until the claim's primary source (journal/DOI page or open-access manuscript) replaces the abstract-page capture.

sources.access_basis_default: publisher abstract page — abstract only; paywalled full text never fetched or circumvented
sources.name: Journal article pages (Journal of Finance, JFE, RFS — publisher/DOI landing pages)
Open-access repositories & author pages (LSE Research Online, EconPapers/RePEc, university author pages)
sources.parked_reason: Review fix: parked until the specific manuscript capture is replaced/confirmed as the primary source of record for the claim (mirror risk).

sources.access_basis_default: secondary replication summary — site terms as posted
sources.name: Papers With Backtest (paperswithbacktest.com)
sources.parked_reason: Review fix: parked as a primary (it is a summary/mirror). The shortlist card's primary must be the paper itself via an ACTIVE primary-capable source.

sources.access_basis_default: per-repo license recorded verbatim (e.g. 'MIT — text evidence only'); code is NEVER executed (hard scope rule)
sources.name: GitHub public repositories (strategy documentation, replications, preregistrations)

sources.access_basis_default: secondary summary — pointers to primary papers only
sources.name: Factor-research summaries (established factor-research blogs/write-ups)

sources.access_basis_default: manual find supplied by Mike in chat; card must still name a verifiable primary source before shortlisting
sources.name: Chat intake (Mike's manual finds: reels, links, claims pasted in chat)
sources.rule: SOURCE_CHAT items enter the store ONLY through the single writer (the weekly idea-harvest-weekly run or a parent-run writer invocation executing recorded events). Chat itself never writes the store; there is no direct chat-to-store path.
